name: Fra Ben Cave
description: Shallow cavern on the north side of Qawra Point, a short swim from the entry. Its opening at 6 m leads some 15 m into a small inland pool open to the sky, with a big rock in the middle you can swim around and come up beside. Lovely light on a sunny day. Combines well with the North Reef and its arch.
conditions: The entrance is hard to spot when the cliff throws a shadow.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
